nodes.description: Admin address granted Covman-only privileges; set to msg.sender in constructor.
Manager address allowed to mint promo/contract covfefes and payout.
Mapping tokenId => owner address; authoritative ownership record.
Mapping tokenId => current sale price; mutated by buyCovfefe and addValueToCovfefe.
Mapping tokenId => previous sale price, snapshot before price updates.
Mapping owner => token balance, incremented/decremented inside _transfer.
Mapping tokenId => approved spender address cleared on transfer.
Array of Covfefe structs (term, meaning, generation, win/loss counts, saleReadyTime).
Nonce counter mixed into the pseudo-random keccak256 seed in randMod.
Counter of promo covfefes, capped by PROMO_CREATION_LIMIT.
Counter of contract covfefes, capped by CONTRACT_CREATION_LIMIT.
ERC721 approve; requires caller owns token, writes covfefeIndexToApproved.
Returns ownershipTokenCount for an owner.
Manager-only promo mint; increments promoCreatedCount and calls _createCovfefe.
Manager-only contract mint; increments contractCreatedCount and calls _createCovfefe.
Payable purchase; updates prices, transfers ownership, pays seller and refunds excess ether.
Payable owner-only meaning update; requires exact addMeaningFee and non-contract caller.
Payable owner-only value injection that raises covfefeIndexToPrice using SafeMath.
CovDweller-only external wrapper that forwards to internal _payout.
Internal _payout; transfers entire contract balance to _to or covmanAddress.
Covman-only reassignment of covmanAddress.
Covman-only reassignment of covmanagerAddress.
Approved spender takes ownership of a token.
Owner-initiated ERC721 transfer.
Third-party ERC721 transfer requiring ownership and approval.
Payable duel; uses randMod outcome to bump win/loss counters on two covfefes.
Pseudo-random generator seeding keccak256 with now, msg.sender and randNonce.
Private mint that pushes a new Covfefe struct and assigns ownership.
Private _transfer updating ownershipTokenCount, owner mapping and approvals.
Sets saleReadyTime to now + SaleCooldownTime.
Timestamp gate returning whether saleReadyTime has elapsed.
View aggregating struct fields and prices for a token.
ERC721 ownerOf with zero-address guard.
Returns covfefes.length.
Iterates whole covfefe array to collect tokens owned by an address.
extcodesize-based check used to block contract callers.
Private ownership predicate against covfefeIndexToOwner.
Private approval predicate against covfefeIndexToApproved.
Private zero-address guard.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, ownership and refund.
block.timestamp (now) used for cooldowns and pseudo-randomness.
oldOwner.transfer(payment) external ether call inside buyCovfefe.
msg.sender.transfer(purchaseExcess) external refund call at end of buyCovfefe.
_to.transfer/covmanAddress.transfer of full contract balance in _payout.
Weak randomness: keccak256(now, msg.sender, randNonce) % _modulus is miner-influenceable.
Price scaling SafeMath.mul(sellingPrice,115)/95 and mul(...,95)/100 arithmetic.
_tokenId parameter of buyCovfefe.
_owner parameter of createPromoCovfefe.
sellingPrice local copy of current price in buyCovfefe.
payment local (95% of sellingPrice) sent to the previous owner in buyCovfefe.
_targetId parameter of duelAnotherCovfefe.
rand local result of randMod(100) in duelAnotherCovfefe.
_newCovman parameter of setCovman.

edges.reason: onlyCovman compares msg.sender to covmanAddress before allowing reassignment.
setCovmanager guarded by onlyCovman modifier checking msg.sender.
payout is restricted by onlyCovDwellers which inspects msg.sender.
createPromoCovfefe guarded by onlyCovmanager using msg.sender.
createContractCovfefe guarded by onlyCovmanager using msg.sender.
approve requires _owns(msg.sender,_tokenId) before granting approval.
buyCovfefe sets newOwner = msg.sender and requires msg.sender is not the current owner.
takeOwnership binds newOwner to msg.sender and requires approval.
transferFrom requires ownership of _from and approval of msg.sender-supplied _to.
transfer requires _owns(msg.sender,_tokenId).
randMod seeds keccak256 with block.timestamp, creating timestamp-dependent randomness.
duelAnotherCovfefe outcome branch depends on randMod result derived from block.timestamp.
_triggerSaleCooldown sets saleReadyTime from now, entangling state with block.timestamp.
_ripeForSale compares stored saleReadyTime against now, gating buyCovfefe on timestamp.
_createCovfefe initializes saleReadyTime = uint64(now).
buyCovfefe performs oldOwner.transfer(payment) external value transfer to a caller-controlled address.
buyCovfefe ends with msg.sender.transfer(purchaseExcess) sending ether back to the caller.
payout forwards execution to the internal _payout helper.
_payout transfers the whole contract balance to an arbitrary address via transfer.
buyCovfefe recomputes price with SafeMath.mul(sellingPrice,115)/95 and mul(...,95)/100.
buyCovfefe writes the new price into covfefeIndexToPrice.
buyCovfefe reads the current price from covfefeIndexToPrice.
addValueToCovfefe increases covfefeIndexToPrice by the scaled msg.value.
buyCovfefe snapshots the old price into covfefeIndexToLastPrice.
addValueToCovfefe snapshots the old price into covfefeIndexToLastPrice.
_transfer writes the new owner into covfefeIndexToOwner.
buyCovfefe calls _transfer(oldOwner,newOwner,_tokenId) to move ownership.
createPromoCovfefe delegates minting to _createCovfefe.
createContractCovfefe delegates minting to _createCovfefe.
setCovman writes the privileged covmanAddress state variable.
setCovmanager writes the privileged covmanagerAddress state variable.
createPromoCovfefe reads promoCreatedCount for the creation limit check.
createPromoCovfefe increments promoCreatedCount.
createContractCovfefe reads contractCreatedCount for the creation limit check.
createContractCovfefe increments contractCreatedCount.
randMod reads randNonce as part of the randomness seed.
randMod increments randNonce each call.
addMeaningToCovfefe overwrites the meaning field inside the covfefes array.
addValueToCovfefe reads covfefe struct fields for the emitted event.
_createCovfefe pushes a new struct entry into the covfefes array.
_tokenId parameter indexes covfefeIndexToOwner/price inside buyCovfefe.
_targetId parameter selects the defending covfefe in duelAnotherCovfefe.
local rand drives the win/loss branch in duelAnotherCovfefe.
payment is derived from sellingPrice using 95/100 scaling arithmetic.
the payment amount feeds the external oldOwner.transfer call.
_owner parameter determines the minted token recipient in createPromoCovfefe.
_newCovman parameter becomes the new privileged covmanAddress.

normalization_plan.reason: _tokenId is only a selector for array/mapping lookups inside buyCovfefe.
_owner only supplies the recipient address for the mint initiated by createPromoCovfefe.
sellingPrice is a transient copy of covfefeIndexToPrice used only within buyCovfefe.
payment exists solely to be sent in the oldOwner.transfer external call.
_targetId merely selects the defending covfefe inside duelAnotherCovfefe.
rand is the direct return value of randMod consumed by duelAnotherCovfefe branching.
_newCovman is immediately stored into the covmanAddress state variable by setCovman.
